def transform(grid):
    # The less frequent color maps to 0; the more frequent color maps to
    # the less frequent color. Verified against both demonstration pairs.
    from collections import Counter
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    rare, common = sorted(counts, key=counts.get)
    return [[0 if v == rare else rare if v == common else v for v in row] for row in grid]

def transform(grid):
    """Map the smallest present color to 0 and each later color to its predecessor."""
    colors = sorted({value for row in grid for value in row})
    mapping = {colors[0]: 0}
    for i in range(1, len(colors)):
        mapping[colors[i]] = colors[i - 1]
    return [[mapping[value] for value in row] for row in grid]
